spans.s:
In the room of ए or ओ (in the body of a word), + अ of the case-affix अस् of the Ablative and Genitive Singular, the single substitute is the form of the precedent.

Terms: संहितायाम्

After a Pronominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in अ , स्मात् is substituted for the Dative -4th Case ending अस् and स्मिन् for the Locative -7th case ending इ।

Terms: Some substitution
